status.source: the official NBL play-by-play and shot positions republished by nblR (JaseZiv/nblr_data), NBL19-NBL26

groups.name: Primary Ball Handler
groups.desc: Runs the offence: the most assists and the most shots of his own, many off the dribble and from mid-range.

groups.name: Scoring Guard
groups.desc: A high-usage scorer who also creates for others: pull-ups, threes and drives, fewer assists than a primary handler.

groups.name: Pass-First Playmaker
groups.desc: Sets others up at a lower usage, guard or point-forward: lots of assists and steals, a balanced shot diet.

groups.name: Volume Shooter
groups.desc: Lives behind the arc: the highest share of threes, mostly set up by others.

groups.name: Mid-Range Wing
groups.desc: A wing who scores from the mid-range and in the paint as much as from three.

groups.name: Spot-Up Wing
groups.desc: A low-usage wing who spaces the floor: threes, many from the corners, nearly all assisted.

groups.name: Rim-Running Big
groups.desc: Finishes at the rim and protects it: dunks and lobs, the most blocks and rebounds, almost no threes.

groups.name: Post Big
groups.desc: Scores inside with his back to the basket: hooks and paint shots, offensive boards, trips to the line.

groups.name: Face-Up Forward
groups.desc: A forward who scores from everywhere at a high usage: inside, mid-range and some threes.

groups.name: Stretch Big
groups.desc: A rebounding big who spaces the floor: threes (often from the corners) and finishes at the rim.
